governance.note: neiso-58 = the 2026-07-09-neiso-56-reserve-coopt keeper recipe + neiso_dynamic_reserve_requirements (Limb A, kept on -- real structure that fires in the right event, neiso-57) with ONE structural addition: neiso_offer_surface_conditional=True -- the winter scarcity charter Limb B, the MEASURED ISO-NE fast-start DA offer surface (docs/handoffs/neiso-limb-b-offer-surface-2026-07.md; pre-committed honesty gate section 4). Source: ISO-NE's public DA Energy Market historical offer data (hbdayaheadenergyoffer daily CSVs, masked assets, 1,058 of 1,096 train days published-and-fetched, all 9 DA>$300 tail-event days verified present); population PHYSICS-selected fast-start assets (Claim30 >= 0.9 x EcoMax, ECONOMIC/MUST_RUN; ~110 assets, 1.78M asset-hours); metric per-asset MEDIAN top-of-curve heat-rate multiplier over the model's own Algonquin daily gas and the model fleet's cap-weighted CT_PEAKER HR (9.791); driver within-year net-load percentile (EIA-930 ISNE Demand-WND-SUN), bins 0.80/0.90/0.97 pre-committed; 5 equal-capacity rungs clamped >= all-hours p50 (body 4.318x). Rule-13 admissible: every parameter traces to measured offers conditioned on a forward-reproducible driver; nothing fitted to a price or volume residual; measured PRICES stay validation-only. P1-only additive markup on the CT_PEAKER peak-band rungs (40 rung-rows across 4 bins; tightest bin binds 263 h/yr), carried into the scored P2 pass via the P1 bid-cost objective. PROBE registered per rule 15, result recorded honestly: DORMANT on the scored pass -- the measured wall exists (top rungs ~10.7-18.7x HR, $310-550 at prevailing gas) but the repriced CT_PEAKER rungs never become price-setting: C3c tail unchanged (2025 model 1h vs DA 12h -- the one hour is Limb A's reserve-short RCPF hour, not the wall), C5b storage unchanged (0.827 TWh), CT_PEAKER volume-neutral (max delta -0.0011 TWh/yr), monthly LMP deltas vs the surface-off neiso-57 arm within +/-$2.45 (Nov-2024) and ~$0.00 elsewhere -- no broad elevation, honesty-gate clauses 4/5/6 PASS; charter gates C3c-2025 [6,24]h and C5b-2025 >= 1.456 TWh NOT met. FINDING (handoff section 3 scope clause): in the 11 missed 2025 DA>$300 hours the model clears $256-272 (Jun 24/Jul 29 -- the dual-fuel oil-parity cap region) or $82 (Jul 16 -- the model is not even tight), i.e. the real market's tail forms while the model still carries cheap non-fast-start headroom (CC/imports/oil-parity dual-fuel); repricing the fast-start CT_PEAKER band cannot reach it. The scarcity-anticipation gap, if closable, lives in the broader stack (dual-fuel oil-parity units, imports) or in DA load/virtual bidding -- each would need its own measured identification (rule 13); neither is a tuning knob on this surface (gate clause 3: parameters do NOT move). Zero-forcing twin registered alongside (binds Limb A's event deeper, 2h to $531, as in neiso-57).
